items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: See this is Turo, Colin Picksback Turo.

ctx.x: Did all of those that play together at one time or split them up into bands? Yeah, they put all up there to play together.
They did a variety of things. I guess you can call all these names, couldn't you? Yeah, sure you got it here. See this is Turo, Colin Picksback Turo.
Oh yeah, he even started a leader, wasn't he?
